chars.MOM: MOM: a cheerful plump Moroccan Rifian mother in her mid-50s, round face, bright mustard-yellow headscarf, long emerald-green velvet house djellaba with gold trim, small gold earrings.
chars.SON: SON: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, neat short beard, wearing a burgundy hoodie under an open light-grey denim jacket, black jeans, white sneakers.
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: a shy young Moroccan woman around 25, soft pink headscarf, cream-white kaftan with light blue embroidery, warm smile.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the front doorway of a modest Moroccan house in Al Hoceima: MOM caught mid-act, hurrying excitedly through the living room carrying a big tray of sweets and a teapot at the same time, wide eager smile, eyes shining, rushing. Head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible. Moroccan salon with low sofas behind her.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Evening: SON arriving at the green metal front door of a white Moroccan house in Al Hoceima, a travel bag on his shoulder, tired but smiling, golden dusk light, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the Moroccan living room: MOM grabs SON's arm excitedly and announces big news, beaming; SON freezes with the travel bag still on his shoulder, eyebrows raised, mouth open in surprise. Comic awkward moment, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, warm lamp light in the Moroccan salon: MOM and SON sitting side by side on a low sofa with mint tea glasses; MOM pats SON's shoulder proudly like he became a grown man, SON smiles shyly, a bit embarrassed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night in the Moroccan salon: MOM leaning toward SON whispering advice behind her hand with a cheeky knowing look, SON listening with wide amused eyes, blushing. Light, funny mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night in the Moroccan salon: MOM wagging one finger and giving SON a long serious lecture, counting points on her fingers; SON nodding politely, holding a tea glass, trying not to laugh.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime in the courtyard of the bride's family house in Al Hoceima, potted plants and zellige tiles: SON and BRIDE talking shyly face to face at a respectful distance, SON gesturing toward the road as if explaining he lives far away in Fes, BRIDE smiling and nodding.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a Moroccan salon of the bride's family: SON, MOM and BRIDE with palms raised up together reciting the Fatiha, MOM in the middle beaming with joy, BRIDE shy, SON a little stunned at how fast everything is going. Tea tray and sweets on a low table.
